p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קצג, א):
"Come and see: the ornaments of the Children of Yisrael —
these are the gifts and presents
for they received presents and gifts from all of them.
Once they sinned, what is written?
וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם (שְׁמוֹת לג, ו);
'And the Children of Yisrael stripped themselves of their ornaments' (Shemos 33:6);
these are the 'gifts among men,' etc."
Earlier the Zohar said at length
that Esav and his angelic prince, Samech-Mem,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר (דְּבָרִים לג, ב);
as it says, "And He shone forth from Se'ir" (Devarim 33:2):
And likewise from the prince of Yishmael:
and it explains that about this it says,
with which Yisrael were crowned at Matan Torah,
and one corresponding to "we will hear."
דְּאִיתָא בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בַּמִּדְבָּר רַבָּה טז, י, פָּרָשַׁת שְׁלַח):
for it says in the Midrash (Bamidbar Rabbah 16:10, Parshas Shelach):
Esav — 'he does the will of his Maker';
For the completion of the holiness
was in the middah of fear,
as it says at the last test:
כִּי יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה (בְּרֵאשִׁית כב, יב);
that you are one who fears G-d" (Bereishis 22:12);
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלג, ב):
and as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 133b):
"that fire was included together with water —
Therefore, on account of his completion
he called the son who came out of him
who knew that the completion of his holiness
would be perfected in the middah
as it says (in the Zohar I, there) —
"he does the will of his Maker,"
for they brought their powers into evil:
his power of might only for murder,
to murder and to conquer the world.
only for bodily cravings and evil desires;
each in the middah of the other.
And this is what it says:
what they took from Esav, the power of "we will do";
for "there is wisdom in Edom — believe it,"
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי חֲכָמִים מֵאֱדוֹם (עוֹבַדְיָה א, ח)
as it says, "And I will destroy the wise men from Edom" (Ovadyah 1:8)
that is, the wisdom of Torah she'b'al peh,
only to conquer the yetzer hara.
the power of love and the power of "we will hear."
And had Yisrael been made complete
then the pasuk would have been fulfilled:
"And the nations shall be utterly destroyed" (Yeshayah 60:12);
and from Mount Chorev there would have been destruction
for the nations of the world.
And this is "their ornaments from Mount Chorev."
And then there would have been the completion of the tikkun,
אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם (תְּהִלִּים פב, ו),
that they would not have died
וְהָיָה נִתְבַּטֵּל הַמַּלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת וְהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע,
and the Angel of Death and the yetzer hara would have been nullified,
And afterward, when they became corrupted,
it is written: "And the Children of Yisrael stripped themselves
of their ornaments from Mount Chorev" —
corresponding to "we will do" and "we will hear,"
on account of which it is called Chorev,
And there remained only what they took captive as spoils,
as it says in the holy Zohar there —
until they bring out all the vitality
from the nations of the world in exile;
for this was the purpose of the exiles:
that converts be added to them
all the power of the yetzer hara,
which is the kelipah of Amalek, the evil inclination
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קס, א).
(as it says in the Zohar III 160a).
only they changed their language to the language of Canaan
כְּתִיב אֶצְלָם: וַיִּשְׁבְּ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁבִי (בַּמִּדְבָּר כא, א),
it is written of them, "and he took of him captives" (Bamidbar 21:1),
that he took back even the captives,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.
as it says in the holy Zohar cited above.
to bring out the holy sparks.
to make for it a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there
(as it says in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48) —
that is, to empty the heart of all evil,
which is the kelipah of Amalek, the evil inclination —
"And the nations shall be utterly destroyed" (Yeshayah 60:12) —
from Mount Chorev they shall be destroyed.
And this is what the Arizal wrote:
that they merited at Matan Torah,
corresponding to "we will do" and "we will hear,"
and which Moshe merited and took
in the gift of his portion" —
that he merited at Matan Torah
and then he returns the crowns to Yisrael,
and "the nations shall be utterly destroyed,"
